card: Extracts roughly 800 lines of legacy wallet migration code and methods out of wallet.cpp into a dedicated wallet/migration module. It also moves wallet path and settings helper functions to walletutil, and renames wallet/migrate to wallet/legacybdb to clarify its Berkeley DB focus. The change is purely refactoring and move-only, aiming to reduce the complexity of the primary wallet translation unit without changing behavior.
changed_since_previous: Rebased to accommodate recent wallet changes, also moving the newly added `UpdateWalletSetting` function to `wallet/walletutil`.
evidence: Author description: "It has been noted by many developers that the `wallet/wallet.cpp` file is quite hard to reason about. It is more than 4500 lines long currently and this patch is an attempt to shorten it by around 800 lines by extracting out the wallet migration code into a dedicated `wallet/migration.cpp` file."
problem: `wallet/wallet.cpp` is more than 4,500 lines long and commingles legacy Berkeley DB migration routines with core descriptor wallet operations, making the file harder to navigate and maintain.

risk.why: A mistake during code relocation could introduce runtime errors or regressions during legacy wallet migration or wallet startup setting updates.

scope_notes: Mostly move-only refactor across 16 files (+856/-824 lines), best reviewed using git diff's `--color-moved=dimmed-zebra` option.
summary: Extracts legacy wallet migration methods and public migration functions out of `wallet/wallet.cpp` into a dedicated `wallet/migration.{h,cpp}` module. Moves wallet settings and path helpers to `wallet/walletutil.{h,cpp}`, and renames `wallet/migrate.{h,cpp}` to `wallet/legacybdb.{h,cpp}`.
